study: GPTQ integer-code sensitivity: dense spatial structure (A) and MoE Family D integer codes (C)

dense.pair_convention: (variant, reference); G20261115 == ORIGINAL bitwise, so pairs with G20261115 other than the null are not separate comparisons (no double counting)

moe.replay: Profiler(model, L, K=4).run(calibration cache, FR chosen ids [remapped to cache rows for groupings]) -> quant_eval.quantize_from_acc(..., infos) -> unchanged gptq_quantize with read-only info capture -> W_q.to(bf16) must equal the historical BF16 weights bitwise, else BLOCKED
moe.model_load: MOE_LOAD_LAYERS=1,8,16,23 (layer-wise replay on cached pristine inputs)

alignment.coordinates: original (output row, input column); q stored in original column order
alignment.execution_position: pos[perm[p]] = p; group = pos // 128 (== lazy-batch block, blocksize 128)
alignment.dequant: FP32 scale*(q-zero) with element grid S[r,j]=scale[group[j],r] (solver convention, verified), then .to(bfloat16) (installation cast)

spatial.mask: F[r,j] = q_a[r,j] != q_b[r,j] in original coordinates

orders.original: original column order, segments = contiguous 128-column blocks
orders.ref_exec: columns reordered by the REFERENCE's act-order, segments = its 128-position groups/blocks
orders.var_exec: columns reordered by the VARIANT's act-order

statistics: E_d = P(F_{j+d}|F_j)/P(F_{j+d}) within segments, d in 1,2,4,...,64
row-flip-rate strata (tertiles of rows with >=2 flips): lag-1 pairs / analytic segment-null expectation
flip rate in columns that changed group vs not
spatial.null: per (row, segment) flip counts preserved; positions uniform within the segment; torch.Generator seeds 20261201 + index; 1000 permutations for each primary dense (pair, layer, projection, order), 200 for secondary dense pairs and MoE primary pairs; analytic expectations k(k-1)(128-d)/(128*127) (segment null) and row-only null reported alongside raw E_d
spatial.first_flip_alignment: not performed (optional; would need a matched null)

criteria.cell: primary dense cell = (pair, layer, projection, execution order in {ref_exec, var_exec})
criteria.clustered_cell: E_1 obs > null 99.5 % quantile AND E_1 obs / null mean >= 1.25
criteria.boundary_cell: segment-edge (first or last 8) flips > null 99.5 % quantile AND >= 1.25 x null mean

classification.SPATIAL-CLUSTERING-SUPPORTED: >= 75 % of primary cells clustered in BOTH execution orders and >= 50 % in every projection type
classification.SPATIAL-CLUSTERING-NOT-DETECTED: <= 10 % of primary cells clustered in both execution orders and < 50 % boundary cells
classification.MIXED-SPATIAL-STRUCTURE: otherwise (incl. projection- or layer-dependent clustering, or boundary concentration without general clustering)

code_comparison.metric: R_q = MoE element-weighted code-flip rate / dense element-weighted code-flip rate, matched 'grouping vs ORIGINAL' comparisons (dense 4 non-null, MoE 5), overall and per projection

rule.A-SIMILAR-CODE-DISAGREEMENT: R_q <= 3 overall and in every projection
rule.B-MUCH-LARGER-MOE-CODE-DISAGREEMENT: R_q > 3 overall and in every projection

code_comparison.caveat: sampled 20/240 MoE experts; Hessian perturbation magnitudes and tokens per dimension differ

criteria.causal: no error-feedback causality from spatial association; fixed-act-order replay is a controlled check only

optional.fixed_actorder: dense: variant Hessian with the ORIGINAL permutation for every tensor of the 4 primary pairs; MoE: the 20 experts x 5 groupings; parity: override with the natural permutation reproduces saved weights bitwise; 200-permutation null in the (shared) execution order
optional.feedback_test: not performed: no safe solver variant without substantial changes (design documented)
